title: The Last Gondola (3/3): Untouched - The Finale

characters.Kai: src/anim/cast.py KAI - lucky red Hawaiian shirt, shorts, flip-flops (bag lost)
characters.Ruth: 71, retired ski instructor, grey hair, teal parka and knit hat, calm and sharp
characters.The man on the cable: red ski patrol jacket, pale, fixed smile, frosted goggles; no breath fog
characters.Patroller Dee: real ski patrol, red jacket, ponytail (Part 3)

scenes.narration: ~Something is on the roof. Ruth has stopped shivering. And it's four hours until sunrise.
scenes.visual: recap: ceiling of the cabin, dents, SOMETHING IS ON THE ROOF

scenes.narration: Footsteps crossed the roof. Slow. Heavy.
scenes.visual: ceiling dents moving across, both look up

scenes.narration: Then the handle of the roof hatch began to turn.
Kai grabbed it with both hands and held on. One flip-flop flew off into the dark.
scenes.visual: Kai hanging on the hatch handle, flip-flop falls

scenes.narration: It pulled. He pulled back. Not today, Kai said.
Behind him, Ruth whispered. Keep talking. Don't let me sleep.
So Kai talked. About the surf shop. About waves. About the time a seagull stole his entire lunch.
scenes.visual: Kai talking; thought bubble: beach, seagull

scenes.narration: Ruth laughed. Barely. But she laughed. And the handle stopped turning.
scenes.visual: Ruth smiles weakly; the handle goes still

scenes.narration: Hours passed. The wind died. And the sky over the mountain turned grey.
Then they heard it. Engines. A snowcat below. Voices, with real breath fogging in the cold.
scenes.visual: snowcat lights below, rescuers breathing clouds

scenes.narration: Real ski patrol climbed the tower. Ropes. Harnesses. Clipped on, one step at a time.
scenes.visual: patroller climbing the tower, clipped on

scenes.narration: They lowered Ruth first. Then Kai. Shorts torn. One flip-flop. Frost in his eyebrows.
scenes.visual: Kai lowered on a rope, wrecked

scenes.narration: At the bottom, a patroller named Dee wrapped him in a blanket. You stayed in, she said. That's why you're alive.
scenes.visual: Dee and Kai at the base, blanket

scenes.narration: Kai told her about the man on the cable. The red jacket. The knocking.
Dee went very quiet. We lost a patroller on that line, she said. Twenty years ago tonight. In a storm.
scenes.visual: Dee's face falls; old photo of a smiling patroller

scenes.narration: Kai looked back up at the gondola. Fresh snow covered the roof. Smooth. Untouched. Not one footprint.
scenes.visual: the gondola roof: smooth snow, no prints

scenes.narration: Kai was frozen, scratched, and missing a shoe. But somehow... the shirt survived. Not a single wrinkle.
scenes.visual: insert: the pristine red Hawaiian shirt

scenes.narration: Could be worse, Kai said. And for once, it wasn't.
scenes.visual: Kai and Ruth wrapped in blankets, smiling at sunrise

scenes.narration: Trust him? Would you have opened that door? Tell me in the comments, and follow. Tomorrow, Kai's next worst day.
scenes.visual: end card: TRUST HIM? / NEW STORY TOMORROW
